# `spec.compile`: Compile spec

Recompiles a Model Spec: rebuilds changed parts (or all with force) and restores part objects.

- Category: spec
- Version: 1
- Complexity: the rebuilt parts' build costs
- Flags: undoable, creates_objects
- Also known as: rebuild spec, recompile, build spec

`spec.set` and `spec.patch` compile already. Run this after editing part meshes by hand (the edits are replaced; keep manual work in a part's `edits`), after deleting part objects, or with `force` after an upgrade.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `force` | `boolean` | `false` | Rebuild every part, even unchanged ones. |
| `target` | `string` | required | The spec's root object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"force":true,"target":"lamp"}
```

Result: `spec lamp (o:1): 2 parts, 2 built, 0 unchanged
  base (cylinder) 200 x 20 x 200 mm at (0, 10, 0) mm, 112 faces
  pole (cylinder) 20 x 400 x 20 mm at (0, 220, 0) mm, 32 faces`
